newsitem.title: USA: Pegasystems files for 2.2 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Pegasystems files for 2.2 mln share offer.

text.p: Pegasystems Inc said on Wednesday it filed a registration statement for a 2.245 million share public offering of common stock.
The company said it would sell 1.5 million shares and certain stockholders would sell 745,000 shares.
Managing underwriters for the offering are Goldman, Sachs & Co, Cowen & Co and Montgomery Securities, it said.
Pegasystems said it would use proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
It said it granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 336,750 additional shares of common stock, solely to cover over-allotments.
